Robot vacuums are a great way to keep your home clean and free of dust and debris. They are especially useful in large homes, where it can be difficult to reach all the nooks and crannies.

In this article, we'll discuss the best robot vacuums for a large home, over 2000+ square feet, and how they are beneficial in keeping your home clean and dust-free.

In a hurry? Check out our top picks below:

#1. Option For Large Homes 2000+ Sq Ft - Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra

Editor’s Choice

The Roborock S7 is one of the smartest robot mopping and vacuuming combos in the market. It provides an extremely convenient, totally hands-free cleaning experience. Using the Empty Wash Fill Dock, you get automatic dust emptying, mop washing, and robot water tank refilling. The dock even cleans itself too.

Check Price on Amazon

With the usage of one of the top-end navigation technology and powerful suction, the Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra is sure to give excellent and efficient cleaning performance. It won’t waste time bumping into objects or getting stuck, thanks to its advanced, laser-based navigation system. And with a 5200 mAh battery, this robot vac will offer around 2 - 3 hours of run time.

Robot vacuums have become so popular that some people even give them names and consider them as part of the family!

What We Like:

  • The vacuum's ability to self-refill and self-empty allows for uninterrupted cleaning over an extended period of time.
  • The 2.5 L dust bag has a generous capacity for holding a substantial amount of dirt.
  • The LIDAR navigation system ensures efficient cleaning with its precise mapping capabilities.
  • It boasts a strong suction power of 5100 Pa, making it effective in removing hair and other types of debris.

What We Didn’t Like:

  • The vacuum's app can be difficult to use and not user-friendly.
  • It is pricier compared to other available robot vacuums on the market.
  • Some users may have privacy concerns with the addition of a camera on the vacuum.

#2. Option For Large Homes 2000+ Sq Ft - ECOVACS DEEBOT X1 Omni

Runner Up

All-IN-ONE OMNI STATION. A first in the industry. After vacuuming, your DEEBOT returns to the station and automatically empties the dustbin. After mopping, it automatically washes the mop heads and dries them with hot air. Experience a whole new level of freedom from cleaning.

Check Price on Amazon

The ECOVACS DEEBOT X1 Omni robot vacuum is a great option for cleaning a large home due to its impressive battery life, strong suction power, and efficient cleaning capabilities.

First up, the 5200 mAh battery provides a runtime of 2-3 hours, giving it enough power to clean a large home in one go without needing to recharge.

Secondly, the 5000 Pa suction power makes it capable of picking up a variety of debris, including pet hair and dust, making it an excellent choice for homes with pets or high-traffic areas.

What We Like:

  • Utilizes laser navigation for a systematic cleaning process.
  • Boasts a strong suction power of 5000 Pa, ensuring a thorough cleaning.
  • Offers a self-emptying and self-refilling mechanism for added comfort.
  • Features a spacious 3-liter dust bag to store a larger amount of dirt and debris.

What We Didn’t Like:

  • Has a bulky and heavy charging base.
  • Some users may have privacy concerns with the built-in camera.

#3. Option For Large Homes 2000+ Sq Ft - Dreametech L10s Ultra

Lower Priced

Fully Automated Cleaning: Automatic dust collection, mop-cleaning and -drying, water-refilling, solution-adding, fast mapping, and path-planning all combine to make fully automated home cleaning a reality. The convenient auto-empty system utilizes our exclusive DualBoost 2.0 system to blow air into the robot’s dust box and vacuum it into a 3L dust bag, giving you up to 60 days of automatic, hands-off cleaning

The Dreametech L10s Ultra has a powerful battery with a 5200 mAh capacity, allowing for a run time of 2.5 to 3.5 hours. This makes it ideal for cleaning large homes, as the vacuum can clean for a longer period of time without needing to return to its charging station.

In addition, the vacuum has high suction power with a pressure of 5300 Pa. This makes it capable of picking up even the smallest of debris, ensuring a thorough cleaning of your floors.

What We Like:

  • Stylish look
  • Strong suction with 5300 Pa
  • Automatically refills and empties
  • Handy automatic mopping and drying feature

What We Didn’t Like:

  • Cleaning tight spaces can be a challenge
  • Navigation technology is functional but not cutting-edge.

Five Key Benefits Of Robot vacuum If You Live In A Big Home

#1. Ease of Use

Robot vacuums are incredibly convenient to use. You can schedule them to clean on a specific day and time or press a button to start cleaning immediately. They do all the hard work for you so you can sit back and relax.

#2. Time-saving

Cleaning a large home can be time-consuming, but you can free up your schedule with a robot vacuum. The vacuum can clean while you're out of the house or doing other tasks.

#3. Thorough Cleaning

With advanced navigation systems and multiple brushes, robot vacuums are able to clean your home thoroughly and efficiently, even in hard-to-reach areas.

#4. Consistency

Robot vacuums clean consistently and thoroughly every time they run. No more missed spots or uneven cleaning.

#5. Health Benefits

Having a clean home is important for your health, and a robot vacuum can help keep your floors free of dust, dirt, and allergens. With regular use, you can enjoy a cleaner and healthier home.

Can a Robot Vacuum Clean the Entire Home in One Pass?

Yes, in most cases, a robot vacuum can clean an entire home in one go. However, this may depend on the size of your home, the vacuum's battery life, and the vacuum's cleaning path.

Some models have large battery capacities and can clean for a longer period of time, while others may need to return to their charging station and resume cleaning later.

Some robot vacuums are equipped with advanced filtration systems that can remove allergens and other microscopic particles from the air.

It's important to review the specifications of the specific model you're interested in to determine its cleaning capabilities.

How Much Time Can You Save With A Robot Vacuum In Your Home?

Keeping a clean home can be time-consuming, especially if you have a large living space.

However, with the help of a robot vacuum, you can free up your schedule and save time. The amount of time you can save will depend on the size of your home, but let's look at some examples to see the average time savings you can expect.

If you have a 1000 sq ft home, it may take the average person about 1 – 1.5 hours to clean their floors. With a robot vacuum, you can save up to 30 minutes to an hour of your time, depending on the efficiency of the vacuum.

A 2000 sq ft home can take an average person 2 - 2.5 hours to clean their floors. With a robot vacuum, you can save up to an hour of your time.

A 3000 sq ft home can take an average person 3 hours to clean their floors. You can save up to 1.5 of your time with a robot vacuum.

In a 4000 sq ft home, it may take an average person 4 hours to clean their floors. With a robot vacuum, you can save up to 2 to 2.5 hours of your time.

The average person spends 100-150 hours per year cleaning the floors in their home.

Battery life is an important factor to consider when it comes to saving time with a robot vacuum. 

If the vacuum has a short battery life, it will need to return to its charging station before it can continue cleaning. This can add to the cleaning time. So make sure to choose a model with a long battery life, so it can clean your home in one go without any interruptions.

Another factor to consider is the type of debris the vacuum can pick up.

Some robot vacuums are designed to handle pet hair, dust, and other common household debris, while others are equipped to handle larger debris, such as cereal or toy pieces. Make sure to choose a vacuum that can handle the type of debris in your home.

In short, a robot vacuum can save you a significant amount of time when it comes to cleaning your home.

The amount of time you can save will depend on the size of your home, but you can expect to save anywhere from 30 minutes to 2.5 hours of your time.

It's important to choose a vacuum with a long battery life, better navigation, and the ability to handle the type of debris in your home for maximum efficiency.
